description: Scoring to picture: turn HIT POINTS (a cut, an impact, the title card — as seconds from the cue start or SMPTE timecodes) into a TEMPO MAP that lands each hit exactly on a downbeat (or a beat — per hit with hits[].land), staying near your tempo and inside bpm_range. Returns tempo_map [{beat, bpm}] to pass unchanged to doseedo_render_midi / doseedo_render_score / doseedo_session_from_stems, and hits[] with the beat, bar and beat-in-bar each hit lands on — write the accent, stinger or change there. Handles 23.976 / 24 / 25 / 29.97 (";" = drop-frame) / 30 / 50 / 59.94 / 60 fps timecode. Pure math: free, instant, no key needed.

bpm.description: The cue's tempo (20–300) — the map stays as close to it as the hits allow.

bpm_range.description: Allowed tempo range [min, max] (default ±12 % of bpm).

hits.description: The moments the music must land on: [{time_s} (seconds from the cue start) or {timecode: "01:00:12:08"} (film timecode, with fps and start_timecode), label?, land?}] — land = THIS hit's landing ("downbeat" or "beat"; default: the request's land), e.g. the big cuts on bar lines and a quick accent on a beat. A bare number = {time_s}.

land.description: Land hits on bar lines (default) or on any beat — the default for every hit without its own land.

start_s.description: Alternative: the cue start in seconds of film time (informational when hits are time_s).

start_timecode.description: Film timecode of the cue's first downbeat (bar 1); hit timecodes are measured from it.

name: doseedo_tempo_map
title: Tempo map from hit points
